response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.bats END AS bats, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT bats, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT bats, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT bats, tally, share, share - avg_share AS excess_over_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Each player_award row counts as one award; rows are inner-joined to player so only awards matching a known player are counted.
NULL and blank/whitespace-only bats are merged into a single group (shown as an empty string).
The simple average share is the unweighted mean of the per-hand shares (1 divided by the number of hand groups, including the blank group).
